Author: Serpens66
Name: Random Events
Description: Runs configurable Vanilla scenario events in singleplayer skirmishes and Trail missions.

Changes: Fixed a native map-start crash by moving Timeline creation and mutation out of the Script Extender's inline pre-tick hook into a persistent LateUpdate queue.
Added queued, executed, stale, and failed Timeline synchronization diagnostics.
Fixed event scheduling by using Vanilla's twelve-month calendar when the Script Extender reports zero months per year.
Fixed dynamically registered signposts as rabbit sources by supplying their positions through Vanilla's scenario-coordinate path.
Added delayed rabbit-unit outcome diagnostics and rejected saved schedules created with an incompatible calendar basis.
Added monthly and periodic game-time heartbeats to expose stalled or divergent Vanilla calendar readings.
Added before/after prerequisite snapshots for population, farms, granaries, food, rabbits, and registered signposts.
Added Timeline done-flag audits at the due tick and following tick before reusable event records are changed.
Added one emergency signpost search within 50 tiles of the map center when no usable edge signpost exists.
Skipped signpost-dependent events with an error when no registered signpost is available.
Prioritized the registered signpost nearest to the explicit target player's keep and prepared direct events for synchronized target player IDs.
Randomized new edge signposts between 2 and 12 tiles from the map edge and within 100 tiles of the safest candidate.
Preserved saved LobbyModSettings across development builds.
Moved real multiplayer and singleplayer skirmish/Trail detection into the shared GameModeHelper.
Fixed local skirmishes being mistaken for network games, which prevented all random events.
Reduced spacing in the strength controls and added horizontal scrolling for narrow settings views.
Made native signpost resolution tolerant of compatible game DLL updates by validating AOB and structural fallbacks.
If native validation fails, only automatic edge signposts are disabled and a detailed error is logged at Info-visible levels.
Added all 15 Vanilla random events for offline skirmishes and Trail missions.
Added saved deterministic scheduling and safe edge signposts for events that require them.
